title: Markov-Equivalent Conditional Independence Graphs on Path Spaces
abstract: arXiv:2611.20877v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Causal discovery for continuous-time stochastic processes with latent confounding typically faces a trade-off between (i) approaches that are highly informative about the causal structure but are difficult to test statistically, and (ii) approaches that admit practical tests from data but yield more coarse-grained conclusions, potentially not leveraging the direction of time. We introduce W-separation, an asymmetric graphical criterion for directed mixed graphs defined as a quaternary relation that allows distinct conditioning on past and future components. This added flexibility yields a highly informative graphical independence model while preserving testability. W-separation satisfies a global Markov property for a broad class of stochastic differential equations with latent confounding, linking it to conditional independence relations among coordinate processes that are testable from data. translated_title: 路径空间上的马尔可夫等价条件独立性图
translated_abstract: 针对具有潜在混杂因素的连续时间随机过程的因果发现通常面临一种权衡：（i）一类方法能够对因果结构提供丰富的信息，但难以进行统计检验；（ii）另一类方法虽然可以从数据中进行实际检验，但只能得出更粗粒度的结论，并且可能无法利用时间的方向性。我们提出了W-分离（W-separation），这是一种针对有向混合图的非对称图判据，其定义为一种四元关系，允许对过去和未来分量分别进行不同的条件化。这种额外的灵活性在保持可检验性的同时，产生了一个信息丰富的图独立性模型。W-分离对于一大类具有潜在混杂因素的随机微分方程满足全局马尔可夫性质，从而将其与可从数据中检验的坐标过程之间的条件独立性关系联系起来。本工作的一个核心结果是对……的完整刻画（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种名为W-分离的新型非对称图判据，在存在潜在混杂的连续时间随机过程因果发现中，同时实现了丰富的因果结构信息与基于数据的可检验性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces W-separation, a novel asymmetric graphical criterion that achieves both highly informative causal structure and data-testability in causal discovery for continuous-time stochastic processes with latent confounding.
